_comment: Expected results per fixture. The harness asserts these; it does not
just print them. Add your own files to test/fixtures/ and an entry
here — a fixture with no entry is reported as unchecked, never as a
The PDFs themselves are gitignored: some are real sealed documents and
one is a third party's export, so the set is not redistributable. See

postdocsealed.pdf.note: SignedBy seal, Sectigo DocTimeStamp, root pinned

badgeonsealed.pdf.note: Badge-stamped variant; regression guard for the badge pipeline

tampered.pdf.note: One byte flipped in postdocsealed.pdf. The control: if this ever passes, stop and fix it before anything else.

lta-sectigo.pdf.note: PAdES-LTA. Guards the multi-signature fix: the OUTER archive timestamp must be read, not the first one, and the appended update must not be reported as page content.

lta-eurotsa.pdf.note: Archive timestamp from an EC P-384 authority whose root is deliberately not pinned. Untrusted-root is the CORRECT answer here, not a failure.

third-party-cades.pdf.note: An ordinary /adbe.pkcs7.detached signature with a CAdES-T signature timestamp. Guards the fix for the bug where every non-DocTimeStamp PDF threw and rendered red.
